name: command-ack-reconnect-protocol
explain: Implement WebSocket application-layer command acknowledgments and idempotent reconnection. Retains unacknowledged commands in a pending queue and replays them with deterministic operation keys to prevent duplicate side effects.
steps: Dispatch command over WebSocket and commit mutation in server durable ledger. || Replay command on a reconnected socket, returning the cached receipt without executing duplicate mutations.
expect: WebSocket command ACK verified: status=completed, receipt=receipt_order_88, duplicate_mutations=0

name: session-reauth-revocation
explain: Enforce per-command authorization and dynamic session revocation on long-lived WebSockets. Re-checks token validity windows and severs active connections immediately upon administrative credential revocation.
steps: Authorize incoming commands against token expiration timestamps on an active session. || Enforce dynamic permission revocation, immediately rejecting subsequent commands and severing the socket.
expect: WebSocket session auth verified: initial_command_authorized=True, expired_token_rejected=True, revoked_session_closed=True

name: heartbeat-vs-task-monitor
explain: Disentangle transport-level ping/pong heartbeats from application-level agent task progress. Detects stalled agent model tasks even when the underlying WebSocket socket connection remains healthy.
steps: Evaluate WebSocket transport ping/pong liveness against transport timeout thresholds. || Evaluate agent task token emission progress, flagging stalled tasks independently of socket health.
expect: Heartbeat vs task monitor verified: connection_alive=True, task_stalled=True, transport_timeout_detected=True

name: distributed-websocket-broker
explain: Scale stateful WebSockets horizontally across multi-replica clusters using a distributed pub/sub backplane. Broadcasts events across pods to reach locally connected clients without sticky session bottlenecks.
steps: Attach independent WebSocket clients across separate server pod replicas. || Publish completion events to a distributed message bus, delivering events to all connected clients across pods.
expect: Distributed WebSocket scale verified: cross_replica_delivered=True, client_alpha_received=True, client_bravo_received=True

name: binary-text-multiplex-frame
explain: Multiplex raw binary audio PCM frames with typed JSON control frames on a single WebSocket. Ingests microphone audio while processing in-band text interruption commands to halt model synthesis immediately.
steps: Stream raw binary audio chunks into an audio buffer for voice recognition. || Ingest an in-band JSON text interrupt frame, immediately halting audio synthesis for barge-in interactivity.
expect: Binary text multiplexing verified: binary_audio_frames=2, text_control_frames=1, interrupt_handled=True

name: websocket-production-suite
explain: Verify production WebSocket resilience across four mandatory failure modes: reconnection recovery, duplicate command rejection, auth expiration, and slow consumer buffer saturation.
steps: Execute automated checks verifying reconnection cursor recovery and duplicate command idempotency. || Assert that expired auth tokens are rejected and slow consumer buffer saturation is detected.
expect: WebSocket production suite verified: all_checks_passed=True, failure_modes_tested=4

name: causal-sequence-epoch-fence
explain: Enforce causal sequence horizons and session epoch fencing across WebSocket reconnects. Fences out delayed in-flight commands from older sockets and rejects stale sequence numbers to prevent state corruption.
steps: Advance session epoch and commit commands sequentially on an active connection. || Simulate arrival of delayed packets from an older connection epoch, asserting that the server fences and discards them.
expect: Causal sequence epoch fence verified: newer_command_committed=True, delayed_stale_command_fenced=True, duplicate_seq_rejected=True
